h1: The Outside Inn — a garden guesthouse near Ubon airport with spacious rooms and homemade Mexican food
intro: Ubon has a small guesthouse that foreign travellers mention so often it sits near the top of the city's rankings — The Outside Inn, a boutique guesthouse run by Thai-American owners Brent and Tun, open since 2013 · The draw is spacious, clean rooms with high ceilings set around a central garden, plus a restaurant serving Thai, Mexican and Western food · It is close to Ubon airport and the city, breakfast is cooked fresh and free, and parking is free · It scores 9.0 on Trip.com and around 4.7 on TripAdvisor, ranked #2 of 37 B&Bs in Ubon · From approx ฿650/night.
galleryAlts: The central garden and dining area at The Outside Inn Ubon Ratchathani

body.html: What sets The Outside Inn apart from the usual small hotels in Ubon is that it is a guesthouse the owners run themselves · Brent (American) and Tun built it from restored buildings around a central garden dotted with fountains, potted trees and earthen brick · The feel is homely and personal, and the thing guests praise most consistently is the owners and staff — friendly, attentive, and genuinely knowledgeable about where to eat and what to see in Ubon.

Rooms come in two main forms: standard Jasmine and superior Royal Lotus · Both are spacious with high ceilings, tile floors and windows, air-con and ceiling fans, plus a TV, fridge/minibar, hot water and a sitting area · Some rooms have connecting doors, handy for families · Guests agree the rooms are clean, larger than expected for the price, and quiet thanks to being set back from the main road — the trade-off being that the place is genuinely hard to find without GPS.
"The room was huge with high ceilings, spotless. The owners were so friendly and helpful, the homemade Mexican food was the real deal, and breakfast was cooked fresh. Incredible value for Ubon."

The garden restaurant is another big talking point · The Outside Inn serves Thai, Mexican and Western dishes made fresh in-house, along with cocktails from house-infused vodkas and homemade liqueurs · A cooked-to-order breakfast is free with every room, with both Western options and local Isaan noodles · Many reviews point out that made-from-scratch Mexican food is a rarity in Ubon and that it is done well here — one of the reasons guests come back.

To be straight, this is a guesthouse, not a hotel, so there are limits worth knowing · There is no swimming pool, and it is a small property of around 12 rooms with modest facilities · Some reviews mention bathroom odours in a few rooms, curtains that do not close fully, and an occasional band playing in the garden that brings noise at night · The restaurant and bar close fairly early, and the entrance is hard to find without a map · If you want luxury or full hotel facilities, this is not the place.

On location · The Outside Inn sits on Suriyat Road in the Ubon city area, about a 10-minute drive from Ubon Ratchathani Airport (UBP) and only a few minutes by car from Thung Si Mueang and the central sightseeing area · It suits anyone flying in and out of Ubon who wants somewhere quiet with a garden near the airport, or drivers who want free parking · The 9.0 on Trip.com from 28 reviews and the 4.7 on TripAdvisor (ranked #2 of 37 B&Bs in Ubon) show most guests leave very happy.

In short, The Outside Inn is a owner-run garden guesthouse with spacious, clean rooms, good food and a handy location near the airport at a gentle price · It is ideal if you like a homely, personal feel and want local tips straight from the owners, and you are not fussed about a pool or upscale facilities · If you want a city hotel with a pool and full amenities, look at Laithong or one of Ubon's 5-star hotels instead · But for a small, warm stay with homemade Mexican food and hosts who care, this is a well-judged choice.

A tip from following the reviews here: turn on GPS or ask the owners for the pin before you arrive, as the entrance is hard to spot · If you are noise-sensitive, check whether a band is playing in the garden that night when you book · And do not miss the homemade Mexican food and the house cocktails — many guests call them the highlight of the stay.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — The Outside Inn Ubon Ratchathani

faq.q: Where is The Outside Inn in Ubon, and what is nearby?
faq.a: The Outside Inn is at 11 Suriyat Road in the Ubon Ratchathani city area · it is about a 10-minute drive from Ubon airport (UBP) and 7-8 minutes by car from Thung Si Mueang and the central sightseeing area · the entrance is hard to find, so turn on GPS or ask the owners for the pin before you arrive.

faq.q: How much does The Outside Inn cost, and what rooms are there?
faq.a: From approx ฿650/night for a Deluxe Jasmine King · Deluxe Jasmine Twin around ฿700 · Premium Royal Lotus (superior) around ฿950 · connecting family rooms around ฿1,500 · prices move with the season and festivals, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does The Outside Inn have a pool and breakfast?
faq.a: There is no swimming pool · it is a small guesthouse focused on its garden setting and food · breakfast is cooked to order and free with every room, and the garden restaurant serves Thai, Mexican and Western dishes · there is free parking and free Wi-Fi.

faq.q: What are the rooms like at The Outside Inn, and are they spacious?
faq.a: Rooms come in two main types — Jasmine (standard) and Royal Lotus (superior) · both are spacious, with high ceilings and very clean, with air-con, ceiling fans, a TV, fridge, hot water and a sitting area · some have connecting doors for families · the limits some reviews note are bathroom odours and curtains that do not close fully in a few rooms.

faq.q: Who is The Outside Inn best for?
faq.a: It suits travellers who like a homely, owner-run guesthouse feel, want spacious rooms at a gentle price near Ubon airport, and enjoy homemade food · the Thai-American owners are great for local tips · it is less suited to anyone wanting a pool, full facilities or hotel-style luxury.

faq.q: What review score does The Outside Inn have?
faq.a: It scores 9.0 on Trip.com from 28 reviews and around 4.7 on TripAdvisor, ranked #2 of 37 B&Bs/guesthouses in Ubon · most guests praise the spacious, clean rooms, the food, and the friendly, helpful owners.
